hard_constraints: Use Star Wars Legends / Expanded Universe continuity exclusively (Canon Contract: Continuity Branch).
Treat Disney-only continuity as invalid unless also in Legends (Canon Contract: Continuity Branch; canon_profile.cross_continuity_violations).
No anachronistic terms: replace with Star Wars equivalents (canon_profile.anachronistic_terms).
Force described through experiential/mystical language, not scientific (canon_profile.franchise_terminology_notes; force_mechanics.primary_rule).
'Jedi' singular and plural, never 'Jedis'; 'Darth' capitalized before name (canon_constraints.style_constraints).
Veraine's voice: no contractions, complete grammatically sophisticated sentences (terminology_registry.Darth Veraine; scene_card.sensory_details).
canon_risks: Veraine as Brotherhood of Darkness alchemist must align with Legends depiction of faction as organized Sith under Kaan during New Sith Wars (canon_preserved: Brotherhood of Darkness; Darth Bane Trilogy). Risk of portraying as chaotic/disorganized if drafter deviates from strategic role.

Socratic pedagogy in Sith theorist traditions referenced (scene_card.canon_elements_needed): Karness Muur lineage is Legends (Tales of the Jedi), but specific Socratic method may require careful non-invented framing to avoid new lore.
Jedi diplomatic parley posture standard in Legends (e.g., negotiations in Jedi Academy Trilogy), but ensure no modern Inquisitorius bleed in antagonist structure.
legends_continuity_notes: Brotherhood of Darkness: Pre-Ruusan Sith led by Lord Kaan, emphasized collective philosophy over Rule of Two; ended via thought bomb at Ruusan (Darth Bane: Path of Destruction). Veraine fits as strategist/alchemist without contradicting.
Post-Fate of the Jedi (47 ABY): Ben Skywalker ~21, Jedi Knight post-Abeloth; Galactic Alliance government; Jedi Temple on Coruscant under Luke (canon_preserved; era_description).
Force wounds precedents: Nathema (KOTOR), Malachor V (KOTOR II) – persistent damage with unreliable sense, emotional bleed (force_mechanics.canon_grounding).
Vergences/nexuses: Established Legends locations of concentrated Force (e.g., Valley of the Jedi on Ruusan).
required_context_for_drafter: Veraine: AU Brotherhood alchemist/strategist, escaped anchor; philosophy accuses Jedi of crime via living anchors, seeks seal release (primary_antagonistic_force; terminology_registry.Darth Veraine). Socratic questioning only – no monologue/declarations (scene_card.conflict; action_beats).
Kael recruitment: Invokes shared anchor history; his silence is assembling, not refusal (turning_point; key_beats[3]).
Present: Ben, Sera, Torin, Kael, Desh, Veraine (no crew interaction; at distance) (characters_present).
Setting: Neutral cleared area; Veraine's ship visible, gangway down (setting; sensory_details).
Weave/Ankhural heresy: Local vergence structure possibly imposed – Veraine's frame, not proven (force_mechanics; terminology_registry.The Weave).
No resolution: Philosophy compelling, distinction via feel not assertion (stakes.external; anti_patterns).

Ankhural Codex heresy on vergence structure (canon_overridden).
